name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Shishu
description: Micro-loans up to ₹50,000 for starting or early-stage businesses. Covers all non-farm income generating activities.
descriptionHi: नए या शुरुआती व्यवसायों के लिए ₹50,000 तक का ऋण।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Indian citizen, non-farm business activity, no existing default

benefits.description: Collateral-free loan up to ₹50,000 for business startup or expansion

name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Kishore
description: Loans from ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh for growing businesses. Suitable for working capital and asset purchase.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Existing business with growth plans, no existing default

benefits.description: Collateral-free business loan from ₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh

name: PM MUDRA Yojana — Tarun
description: Loans from ₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh for established micro/small businesses for expansion.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Established business with track record

benefits.description: Loan from ₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh for business expansion

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service sectors. Subsidy 15-35% depending on category and location.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Age above 18 years, minimum VIII standard pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹5 Lakh (service)

benefits.description: 15% subsidy for general category in urban areas; 25% for rural; 25-35% for special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/ex-servicemen/minorities/PH/NE region/Hill districts)
Project cost up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for service

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
nameHi: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी ट्रस्ट
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of MSME
description: Provides credit guarantee up to 85% coverage for loans to micro and small enterprises without collateral.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Udyam Registration required, new or existing business

benefits.description: Credit guarantee coverage of 75-85% of loan amount, enabling collateral-free lending

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Holistic support scheme for artisans and craftspeople from 18 traditional trades. Includes recognition, skill training, toolkit support, credit access, and market linkage.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Must belong to one of 18 specified crafts (Blacksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Carpenter, Tailor, etc.)

benefits.description: ₹15,000 toolkit support (upfront after skill training)
Collateral-free credit: ₹1 Lakh (Stage 1), ₹2 Lakh (Stage 2) at 5% concessional rate
Basic (5-7 days) and advanced (15 days) skill training with ₹500/day stipend

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services or trading sector for SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs.

eligibility.otherCriteria: At least one SC/ST or woman borrower per bank branch, greenfield project

benefits.description: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore covering up to 75% of project cost

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
nameHi: पारंपरिक उद्योगों के पुनरुद्धार के लिए योजना
description: Organizes traditional industries and artisans into clusters to make them competitive and self-sustaining. Provides infrastructure support.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Traditional industries like Khadi, Coir, Bamboo, Honey, Pottery etc.

benefits.description: Soft intervention ₹25 Lakh per cluster; Hard intervention ₹1.5 Crore; Major intervention ₹2.5 Crore

name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) Certification
description: Quality certification for MSME products with subsidy up to 80% for the certification fee. Boosts quality and competitiveness for domestic and export markets.

benefits.description: Subsidy on certification fee: 80% for micro, 60% for small, 50% for medium enterprises

name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (CLCSS)
description: 15% capital subsidy for technology upgradation for small enterprises in manufacturing. Helps upgrade to state-of-the-art technology.

benefits.description: 15% upfront capital subsidy on institutional credit for technology upgradation, maximum subsidy ₹15 Lakh

name: Design Clinic Scheme
description: Brings design expertise to MSME manufacturing clusters to improve product design, reduce costs and improve marketability.

benefits.description: Subsidy of 75% on design project costs for micro enterprises, 60% for small/medium (max ₹40 Lakh per project)

name: Startup India — DPIIT Recognition & Benefits
description: Official DPIIT recognition unlocks multiple benefits: income tax exemption for 3 years, fast-track patent filing (80% fee rebate), self-certification for labour laws, government tender exemptions.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Incorporated <10 years ago, annual turnover <₹100 Crore, working on innovative product/service

benefits.description: Income tax exemption for 3 consecutive years under 80-IAC
80% rebate on patent filing fees
Exemption from prior experience/turnover criteria for government tenders

name: NSIC — Raw Material Assistance
description: Helps MSMEs procure raw materials on easy credit terms. NSIC acts as facilitator for bulk procurement discounts.

benefits.description: Working capital credit for raw material procurement with 3-6 month credit period, financing up to 75% of cost

name: MSME Champions Scheme
description: Cluster development scheme to upgrade MSMEs through Competitive, Lean, Digital, Quality and Sustainable interventions.

benefits.description: Subsidized consultancy and intervention services for lean manufacturing, digital transformation, quality and sustainability

name: A Scheme for Promoting Innovation, Rural Industries & Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
description: Sets up technology business incubators and livelihood business incubators in rural areas to promote innovation in agro-industries.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Rural entrepreneurs, focus on agro-based businesses

benefits.description: Setting up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) with ₹1 Crore support per incubator and Technology Business Incubators (TBI) with ₹5 Crore support
Skill training and mentorship for rural entrepreneurs

name: PLI Scheme for Textiles — MMF Apparel & Technical Textiles
nameHi: वस्त्र उद्योग के लिए PLI योजना
description: Production Linked Incentive for manufacturing Man-Made Fibre (MMF) apparel, MMF fabrics, and technical textiles. Incentive of 15% for first 2 years, 11% for next 3 years.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Minimum investment of ₹30 Crore for MMF apparel; turnover growth benchmark

benefits.description: Production Linked Incentive: 15% on incremental turnover (year 1-2), 11% (year 3-5), 8-3% (year 6-10). Total outlay ₹10,683 Crore.

name: PLI Scheme for Food Processing Industry
nameHi: खाद्य प्रसंस्करण के लिए PLI योजना
description: Production Linked Incentive to boost food manufacturing and create global champions. Covers Ready-to-Cook, Ready-to-Eat, marine products, mozzarella cheese etc.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Minimum sales threshold varies by category

benefits.description: Incentive of 10% on incremental sales over base year for first 2 years, reducing to 3% by year 6. Total outlay ₹10,900 Crore.

name: SIDBI Direct Lending — MSME Loans
description: SIDBI's direct lending programs for MSMEs including term loans for capacity expansion, equipment finance, and working capital.

benefits.description: Term loans and working capital from ₹10 Lakh to ₹25 Crore at competitive rates (8.5-13% depending on risk profile)

name: SAMRIDH — Startup Accelerators of MeiTY for Product Innovation and Development
description: Provides funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup and connects to investors for IT/tech MSMEs and startups.

eligibility.otherCriteria: Technology startup with functional product/prototype, incorporated <10 years

benefits.description: Funding up to ₹40 Lakh per startup + investor network access + mentorship

name: Digital MSME Scheme
description: Promotes digital transformation of MSMEs through subsidized cloud computing adoption, digital payments, e-commerce integration and digital marketing.

benefits.description: Subsidy of 45-75% on cloud subscription costs (ICT tools) for 3 years. Micro: 75%, Small: 60%, Medium: 45%

name: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (A-TUFS)
description: Capital subsidy for technology upgradation in the textile sector. Provides 15% Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) for specified segments like garmenting, technical textiles, and weaving.
descriptionHi: वस्त्र क्षेत्र में प्रौद्योगिकी उन्नयन के लिए पूंजी सब्सिडी।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Textile manufacturing units undertaking technology upgradation

benefits.description: 15% Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) for garmenting/technical textiles; 10% for weaving/processing; max subsidy ₹30 Crore per unit

name: Trade Related Entrepreneurship Assistance and Development (TREAD)
nameHi: व्यापार संबंधित उद्यमिता सहायता एवं विकास (TREAD)
description: Empowers women entrepreneurs through capacity building, counselling, training, and handholding. Government grant up to 30% of the loan/credit sanctioned by lending institutions to women-led projects.
descriptionHi: महिला उद्यमियों को प्रशिक्षण और 30% तक अनुदान सहायता।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Women entrepreneurs, proposals routed through NGOs

benefits.description: Government grant up to 30% of total project cost (maximum ₹30 Lakh per project); remaining 70% as loan from banks
Capacity building and entrepreneurship development training for women

name: Telangana T-IDEA (Industrial Development & Entrepreneur Advancement)
nameHi: तेलंगाना T-IDEA (औद्योगिक विकास एवं उद्यमी उन्नति)
description: State incentive scheme offering investment subsidy, power tariff subsidy, stamp duty reimbursement, and land cost rebate for MSMEs setting up in Telangana.
descriptionHi: तेलंगाना में MSME स्थापित करने के लिए निवेश सब्सिडी और अन्य प्रोत्साहन।

eligibility.otherCriteria: New or expanding manufacturing units in Telangana

benefits.description: Investment subsidy: 15-35% on fixed capital investment; Power tariff subsidy ₹1-2/unit for 5 years; 100% stamp duty reimbursement

name: Maharashtra Industrial Development Programme (MIDP)
description: Comprehensive incentive package for MSMEs in Maharashtra including Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS), stamp duty exemption, electricity duty exemption, and interest subsidy.
descriptionHi: महाराष्ट्र में MSME के लिए व्यापक प्रोत्साहन पैकेज।

eligibility.otherCriteria: New or expanding manufacturing units with Udyam Registration

benefits.description: Industrial Promotion Subsidy (IPS): Net SGST refund for 7-10 years (capped at 40-100% of fixed capital based on zone); 100% stamp duty exemption; electricity duty exemption for 7-15 years

name: Gujarat iCreate — International Centre for Entrepreneurship and Technology
nameHi: गुजरात iCreate — अंतरराष्ट्रीय उद्यमिता एवं प्रौद्योगिकी केंद्र
description: Incubation and acceleration centre for hardware and IoT startups. Provides prototyping lab, mentorship, seed funding, and global market access.
descriptionHi: हार्डवेयर और IoT स्टार्टअप के लिए इनक्यूबेशन केंद्र।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Hardware/IoT startups and tech entrepreneurs

benefits.description: Seed funding up to ₹25 Lakh; free prototyping lab access; mentorship; global market connect
6-month residential incubation programme with access to fabrication lab and industry mentors

name: Karnataka Elevate — Startup Programme
description: Identifies, promotes and fast-tracks promising startups in Karnataka. Provides seed funding, mentorship, investor connects, and government procurement preference.
descriptionHi: कर्नाटक में आशाजनक स्टार्टअप को सीड फंडिंग और मेंटरशिप।

eligibility.otherCriteria: DPIIT recognized startup registered in Karnataka

benefits.description: Seed funding up to ₹50 Lakh per startup; marketing and branding support
Priority for government procurement; showcase at national and international events

name: TANSIDCO — Tamil Nadu Small Industries Development Corporation Schemes
nameHi: TANSIDCO — तमिलनाडु लघु उद्योग विकास निगम योजनाएं
description: Provides developed land and sheds in industrial estates, term loans, raw material assistance, and marketing support for MSMEs in Tamil Nadu.
descriptionHi: तमिलनाडु में MSME के लिए भूमि, शेड, ऋण और विपणन सहायता।

eligibility.otherCriteria: MSMEs in Tamil Nadu, priority for SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs

benefits.description: Term loan up to ₹2 Crore for land, building, machinery; allotment of developed plots and ready-built sheds at subsidized rates
Marketing support through exhibitions and government order procurement assistance

name: PLI Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
description: Production Linked Incentive to promote domestic manufacturing of high-value pharmaceutical products including complex generics, patented drugs, APIs, and KSMs.
descriptionHi: उच्च मूल्य वाले फार्मा उत्पादों के घरेलू विनिर्माण को प्रोत्साहन।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Pharmaceutical manufacturers with minimum investment threshold; two groups based on revenue

benefits.description: Incentive of 3-10% on incremental sales over base year for 6 years. Total scheme outlay ₹15,000 Crore.

name: PLI Scheme for IT Hardware & Electronic Components
nameHi: आईटी हार्डवेयर एवं इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कंपोनेंट्स के लिए PLI योजना
description: Production Linked Incentive for manufacturing laptops, tablets, servers, all-in-one PCs, and electronic components in India.
descriptionHi: भारत में आईटी हार्डवेयर और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कंपोनेंट विनिर्माण को प्रोत्साहन।

eligibility.otherCriteria: IT hardware manufacturers with minimum investment and incremental production thresholds

benefits.description: Incentive of 1-4% on net incremental sales for 6 years. Total outlay ₹17,000 Crore.

name: RAMP — Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance
nameHi: RAMP — MSME प्रदर्शन उन्नयन एवं त्वरण
description: World Bank-assisted programme to improve MSME access to market and credit, strengthen institutional framework, and enhance technology adoption and inclusiveness.
descriptionHi: विश्व बैंक सहायता प्राप्त MSME प्रदर्शन सुधार कार्यक्रम।

eligibility.otherCriteria: MSMEs across India, focus on credit-starved and technology-lagging units

benefits.description: ₹6,062 Crore programme covering market access support, technology upgradation, credit flow improvement, and green manufacturing initiatives
Capacity building, digital skill training, and institutional strengthening

name: MSME Innovative Scheme (Incubation, Design, IPR)
description: Merged scheme combining Incubation, Design Clinic, and IPR facilitation for MSMEs. Supports product innovation, design improvement, and intellectual property protection.
descriptionHi: MSME के लिए इनक्यूबेशन, डिज़ाइन और बौद्धिक संपदा अधिकार सुविधा।

benefits.description: Incubation support up to ₹15 Lakh per idea; Design project subsidy up to 75% for micro; IPR reimbursement: patents (₹5 Lakh domestic, ₹25 Lakh international), trademarks (₹2 Lakh), GI (₹5 Lakh)

name: Coir Vikas Yojana
description: Comprehensive scheme for development of coir industry including skill upgradation, technology modernization, trade and export promotion, and coir cluster development.
descriptionHi: कॉयर उद्योग विकास के लिए व्यापक योजना — कौशल, प्रौद्योगिकी, निर्यात प्रोत्साहन।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Coir workers, artisans, and coir manufacturing units, primarily in Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh

benefits.description: Machinery subsidy up to 40%, skill training with ₹1,000 stipend/month, export market development assistance
Skill upgradation training (2-6 months) with stipend for coir workers

name: USTTAD — Upgrading the Skills & Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development
nameHi: USTTAD — पारंपरिक कला/शिल्प में कौशल उन्नयन एवं प्रशिक्षण
description: Preserves and promotes the rich heritage of traditional arts and crafts of minority communities. Provides skill training, design development, and market linkages.
descriptionHi: अल्पसंख्यक समुदायों की पारंपरिक कलाओं और शिल्पों के संरक्षण एवं प्रोत्साहन के लिए योजना।

eligibility.otherCriteria: Master craftsmen and artisans from minority communities

benefits.description: Skill training for 6-12 months; ₹500/day stipend; toolkit support worth up to ₹10,000
Marketing support through Hunar Haat exhibitions across India

name: NSIC — Marketing Support & Single Point Registration (SPRS)
nameHi: NSIC — विपणन सहायता एवं एकल बिंदु पंजीकरण
description: NSIC registration enables MSMEs to get preference in government purchases, exemption from earnest money deposit (EMD) and security deposit in government tenders, and free listing on government e-marketplace.
descriptionHi: सरकारी खरीद में MSME को प्राथमिकता — EMD और सुरक्षा जमा से छूट।

benefits.description: Exemption from EMD and security deposit in government tenders; preferential treatment in government procurement under Public Procurement Policy (25% reservation for MSMEs); consortia formation support for large tenders
